convertibility_reason: The EA relies on SYMBOL_SESSION_BUY_ORDERS, SYMBOL_SESSION_SELL_ORDERS, SYMBOL_SESSION_BUY_ORDERS_VOLUME, and SYMBOL_SESSION_SELL_ORDERS_VOLUME which are MT5 exchange/session statistics not available as standard built-in indicator calls. These are broker-dependent market depth sentiment metrics requiring custom data feed implementation in Python. Additionally, Sleep() in OnTick blocks the thread, requiring architectural change.

other_exits: Close position when sentiment ratio weakens: for SELL pos (pos==2), close if DiffVolumesCurr < MinDiffVolumesEx OR DiffTradersCurr < MinDiffTradersEx
Close position when opposing sentiment strengthens: for BUY pos (pos==1), close if DiffVolumesCurr > 1/MinDiffVolumesEx OR DiffTradersCurr > 1/MinDiffTradersEx
Close position when outside trading time window (CheckTradingTime returns false)
Position closed via CTrade.PositionClose when pos==false or !CheckTradingTime()

custom_logic_notes: Sentiment-based EA using session order/volume ratios (SYMBOL_SESSION_BUY_ORDERS, SYMBOL_SESSION_SELL_ORDERS, SYMBOL_SESSION_BUY_ORDERS_VOLUME, SYMBOL_SESSION_SELL_ORDERS_VOLUME). Uses adaptive thresholds: entry requires higher thresholds (DiffVolumesEx=2.0, DiffTradersEx=1.5), but after opening a position the thresholds lower to MinDiffVolumesEx=1.5 and MinDiffTradersEx=1.3 for the holding/exit logic. Sleep(60000*Sleep) called in OnTick which blocks the EA thread for minutes - in Python this should be replaced with a timer/bar-based check. The pos variable is typed as int but used as a boolean flag (false=0, 1=BUY, 2=SELL) which is a type mismatch. Zero-division guards replace 0 values with 1 for order counts and volumes. Magic number is hardcoded as 68975. Trading window is Mon-Fri 10:15:30 to 23:35:30 server time. SL/TP use gTickSize (SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE) instead of _Point, meaning pip values are in tick-size units not point units.
python_conversion_notes: 1) Session sentiment data (SYMBOL_SESSION_BUY_ORDERS etc.) has no direct Python equivalent - need to source order book / commitment of traders data or use a custom MT5 bridge to stream these values. 2) Remove Sleep() blocking call - replace with time-based gate or bar-based evaluation. 3) SL/TP uses SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE not _Point - ensure pip-to-price conversion accounts for this; no digit adjustment needed since tick_size is used directly. 4) The adaptive threshold logic (switching from entry thresholds to lower maintenance thresholds after opening) must be preserved in state machine. 5) Exit logic for BUY checks inverted ratios (1/DiffVolumes, 1/DiffTraders) which is the buy-side sentiment dropping - ensure this asymmetry is preserved. 6) Time filter uses server time with specific minute/second granularity (10:15:30 to 23:35:30). 7) Position close uses CTrade.PositionClose which closes by symbol - in Python use position_close_by_symbol equivalent.
